Name: (CP) BB's New Livestock- Quetzalcoatlus and Ikrans
Author: Bibliobeast
Description:
[b]Increase your animal diversity by adding Quetzalcoatlus to your barn![/b]

[size=3]﻿After donating an elongated opalized pterosaur egg to the museum, Gunther presented you with a leathery egg. When Marnie caught wind of your find she reached out to an old penpal at DewGen (again), a somewhat shady genetics research organization. You don't know how they did it, but they brought Quetzalcoatlus back to life. See below for unlock methods, beware spoilers!

[u]Features[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds Quetzalcoatlus as a new animal to Marnie's shop! This is not a reskin of the dinosaur. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Quetzalcoatlus will produce an item every 2 days; an egg or a custom fish Xenacanthus.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]**NEW** Xenacanthus are also catchable in the [/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Sewers[/size][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][size=3]Eggs can be converted into mayonnaise (1 egg : 1 mayo), pickled (3 eggs : 1 pickled eggs), opalized in the crystalarium (yes, you heard that right!), sold, given to grateful villagers, or hatched using an ostrich incubator in the barn to hatch a Quetzalcoatlus chick! [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Mod comes in 2 play styles, available in the configurations menu of GMCM﻿﻿﻿: Unlock Required and No Unlock. Also has options to toggle how often a key item to unlock the species drops .[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[u]Unlocking the Species at Marnie's[/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Magma Geodes have a 10% chance to drop an opalized Quetzalcoatlus egg. This drop rate will increase by toggling the Drop Precedence in the GMCM menu to -200. Donate this to the museum and you will receive a Quetzalcoatlus egg that you can then hatch in an ostrich incubator. The next day Marni will send you a letter stating that purchasing Quetzalcoatlus is now available.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=3][u]Unlocking the [/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3][u]Void[/u][/size][/spoiler]
[size=3][u]Skin[/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]After having 2 hearts of friendship with Krobus, Marnie will send you a letter. Void skin now available.[/size][/spoiler]


[u][size=3]Unlocking the [/size][/u]
[spoiler][u][size=3]Ikran[/size][/u][/spoiler]
[u][size=3]Skin[/size][/u]
[spoiler][size=3]Acquire a Xenacanthus by either raising friendship with your Quetzalcoatlus and receiving it as a drop or fishing for one in the Sewers. Check your crafting tabs and craft Unusual DNA using a Xenacanthus and a Quetzalcoatlus egg. Donate this to the museum and you will receive a letter. Ikran skin now available.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=5][u]﻿Installation Notes
[/u][/size][size=3]I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23721]Extra Museum Space[/url]﻿﻿ so you don't run out of room with the new mineral, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]﻿ to add Quetzalcoatlus to Marnie's shop smoothly and select specific skins. NOTE: MISSING THE SPECIAL SKINS AT FIRST IS NOT A BUG. See spoilers above if you need clarification. [/size][size=3]﻿﻿

This mod requires both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿ to work correctly! [/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][size=3]Download and install the latest SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size][size=3]Download and unzip "[CP] BBs New Livestock-Quetzalcoatlus" ver 1.0[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\[/size][/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Enjoy![/size][/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Note on Skins- If you do not have Livestock Bazaar, though I highly recommend it, you will have to set the skin that appears in Marnie's shop manually using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿, and choosing a default. If you do not have either Livestock Bazaar or GMCM, you can still get different Quetzalcoatlus skins, however it will be dependant on RNG and you must still unlock them, as the non-common skins have a lower probability of hatching from eggs (1/2 as likely).[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][u]Patch Notes
[/u][/size][size=3]Ver 1.1 - Fixed Ikran skin issue and updated Ikran unlock method, see spoilers but in-game instructions have been updated. Fixed secret skin unlock config. [/size]
[size=3]Ver 1.0.1 - Reset version naming convention, updated fishing location of Xenacanthus to the sewers, shouldn't cause problems with finishing fishing collection or crafting unusual dna now. [/size]
[size=3][u]
Future Update Wishlist
[/u][/size][size=3]- Add working aquarium sprite. Sprite is designed but I can't for the life of me get the sprite to load in so shelving it for now![/size]
[size=3]- More skin variety[/size]
[size=3]-Custom questline for immersive unlock (may combine into a larger questline with my other prehistoric mods to spice up a 'Jurrasic Farm' style playthrough, no promises yet though haha)[/size]
